stories.title: Glamping site plans near Mold refused over heritage, highway and River Dee concerns
stories.summary: Plans for a glamping and horse riding holiday site at a farm near Nercwys have been refused by Flintshire County Council. stories.title: Giant flowers installed across Eastgate Square shopping centre in Chester
stories.summary: Giant flowers have been installed across Eastgate Square shopping centre in Chester for the summer. stories.title: Flintshire records second highest council tax collection rate in Wales
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council collected 97.2 per cent of the council tax it was owed in 2025/26, the second highest rate of any council in Wales. stories.title: North Wales Police target illegal off-road biking at Halkyn
stories.summary: North Wales Police have carried out patrols at the Pentre Halkyn protected nature site following reports of off-road vehicles being used there. The patrols were run by the force’s Rural Crime Team and Neighbourhood Policing Officers, working with a Natural Resources Wales officer. stories.title: North Wales Police issue warning over rise in online shopping scams
stories.summary: A warning has been issued to residents across North Wales following a rise in reports of scams surrounding online shopping.
